placements.role: Designs and fabricates switchgear and bus systems for utility and data-center power distribution.

role_evidence.claim: Powell's 2025 Form 10-K lists distribution switchgear, medium-voltage breakers and bus duct among its products and identifies data centers among the customers for its commercial and industrial market.

business_summary: Powell Industries, Inc. is a Houston-based, Nasdaq-listed manufacturer of custom-engineered switchgear, medium-voltage circuit breakers, bus duct and integrated power control rooms. Its historical core markets are oil and gas, petrochemical and LNG; utility and commercial work, including data centres, is the newer leg. It is by far the smallest issuer in this batch by market capitalisation and the only one whose fiscal year ends in September.

exposure_summary.narrative: Powell has one placement, on power-equipment, the chain's money corner and its most UNDISCOVERED link. That single placement is the cleanest exposure in the batch: it is a switchgear manufacturer and nothing else, so the link's demand and the company's revenue are close to the same variable. Its own fiscal third-quarter 2026 release names a single data-centre order above four hundred million dollars, which is a disclosed, dated, order-level attribution rather than a thematic claim.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No data-centre revenue percentage is disclosed. The fiscal third-quarter 2026 release (accession 0000080420-26-000103) discloses one named data-centre mega order and a total backlog figure, but does not break revenue out by end market.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 1571781222.38 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 154788000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth. The discount rate and terminal growth are assumed, so the solve is an assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': -0.0734, '7': -0.0511, '10': -0.0343}). It measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a statement about price, and inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.

crowdedness_caveats: This is the least covered name in the batch and the one where the un-crowded claim survives contact with the data: data/market/POWL.json pcs records 4 analysts as of 2026-08-29 against 25 for Eaton and 33 for GE Vernova.

Institutional ownership is nonetheless 93.5% and short interest 10.2% of float in the same pcs block, so thin sell-side coverage is not the same as an unowned or uncontested stock; the short interest is the highest in this batch by a wide margin.
Axis-A is COVERAGE-THIN at 100.0 rather than DARK, which is the honest reading: the retail-attention measurement is thin rather than confidently quiet, and the pcs gate state is ADVISORY.
The 52-week range in data/market/POWL.json runs 85.7167 to 322.05, a spread that makes any single-date crowdedness reading fragile.

data_gaps: Net debt to EBITDA is NULL: the last total_debt observation in companyfacts is 2022-09-30 and reads zero, while the cash balance is 2026-06-30, so the two legs sit four fiscal years apart and pairing them would fabricate a ratio.
Piotroski is PENDING_DATA in data/market/POWL.json quality: only one common fiscal period across the nine inputs, and the change legs need at least two.
No end-market revenue split is disclosed, so the data-centre exposure is measurable only at order level and only for the orders the company chooses to name.

A three-for-one forward stock split effected 2026-04-02 is disclosed in the fetched release; per-share figures across the fetched series are not split-adjusted by this profile and none are used as canonical metrics.
The fetched EDGAR document is a fiscal-Q3 8-K exhibit rather than the 10-K, so segment and backlog definitions come from the release footnotes only.

disposition.basis: The cleanest single-link exposure to the money corner in this batch, with the thinnest sell-side coverage and a named data-centre order behind the role claim. Retained rather than advanced because leverage and earnings quality are both unmeasurable from the local store, and because 10.2% short interest and a 85.7167 to 322.05 fifty-two-week range say the name is contested rather than overlooked. Selection is a separate command.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis; where a market price enters the computation the basis says so explicitly, because the price leg is the repo's own dual-source market plane (data/market/POWL.json, price_status AGREED) and not an issuer document. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found, never estimated.
